metadata.dataSource: Curated U.S. data center facility dataset + IM3 footprint join + US Census geocoder + WRI Aqueduct + EPA eGRID
notes: Facility locations and attributes compiled and maintained for this project.
Coordinates from US Census batch geocoder with Nominatim fallback.
Campus parent listings omitted when child facilities are present.
Multi-tenant building shells omitted when tenant listings exist at the same address.
Same-operator duplicate listings at the same site are merged.
Footprint: reported specs/description first; IM3 atlas sqft within 150 m when missing.
IT load: specs → footprint → operator/market median → capacityType prior.
County P90 uses only footprint- or specs-based MW (excludes category guesses).
Site-level BCI shown only when size is footprint-, specs-, or median-based.
